title: A quantified Gibbons-Hawking N-body cluster model
exact_target: Combine asymptotic geometry of toric hyper-Kähler quotients with N-body analytical techniques.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002526 (AIM-PHYSICS-0034). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: This is a methodological first step rather than a single terminal conjecture. It is related to 20002525 and 20002527 but requests a different approach; no particular Gibbons–Hawking cluster model is invented as the full source target.
